decision: Import is leader-only; followers never get imported data
rationale: Minimize data input and database rows

decision: Store each trade once on the leader account
rationale: User copying to 20 accounts should not create 20 trade rows

decision: Follower P&L is computed at read time and not stored
rationale: Avoids N-times row growth at scale; follower P&L equals leader P&L

decision: All followers trade the same size as the leader (no multiplier)
rationale: User confirmed

decision: Per-follower analytics are derived estimates covered by a variance disclaimer
rationale: User accepted slight variances

decision: User must acknowledge that copy trading does not guarantee identical fills
rationale: Set expectations about variance

decision: User names each copy-trading group
rationale: User-defined label

decision: An account may belong to multiple groups; user is responsible for tracking
rationale: User decision

decision: Membership changes are forward-only and stored as dated events with an optional note
rationale: Old trades keep the follower set they actually had

decision: Add Individual and Groups sub-tabs; Groups shows group name / account / account P&L / cumulative group P&L
rationale: User spec

decision: Accounts in multiple groups highlighted light yellow with hover/click to show other groups
rationale: User spec

decision: A follower's derived P&L is included in that account's own totals
rationale: User confirmed; equity and payout tracking should reflect reality

decision: Show grouped trade once with group name as primary label and leader truncated ID (first 3...last 3) as secondary
rationale: User spec

decision: Journal entry attaches to leader trade and applies to whole group; no per-follower notes
rationale: User confirmed

decision: Trade detail lists follower accounts; clicking one opens popup reusing dashboard analytics code scoped to that account
rationale: User spec

decision: Account filter includes groups and individual accounts
rationale: User confirmed

decision: Desktop-first; mobile out of scope for this feature
rationale: Users expected to be on computers

decision: No migration of existing data
rationale: Owner is only user and has no existing copy-trade data

decision: Owner will test with his own copy-traded accounts after release
rationale: User statement

decision: Membership is by trading day: a follower counts a leader trade when the trade's trading day is on or after the add date and before the remove date
rationale: Trades already carry a trading day (the person's own session); a day is what the owner records a change against

decision: Followers chosen when a group is made count from an optional 'Copying since' day; left empty they count every leader trade
rationale: The leader's history is usually imported after copying started; forward-only (row 9) applies to changes made after the group exists

decision: A change after the group exists (add or remove a follower) takes effect today or later; an earlier day is refused
rationale: Row 9: old trades keep the follower set they had

decision: An account leads at most one group; to copy to more accounts add followers to that group
rationale: Each trade then has exactly one group name for the Trades page label (row 13)

decision: The leader is fixed for the life of a group and cannot be one of its own followers
rationale: Changing the leader would rewrite which trades the group had

decision: A follower's copy of a trade carries the leader's gross; fees and net P&L unchanged; the follower's own fee schedule is not applied
rationale: Spec section 3: follower P&L equals the leader's P&L; no per-follower rows

decision: Copies are not chained: a follower that also leads another group passes on only its own imported trades; never the copies it receives
rationale: Avoids counting one trade twice through a chain; spec section 5 says a follower may lead another group

decision: Dashboard; reports; calendar; share cards and the Accounts tab count each follower's copy as a trade of that account (20 accounts = 20 trades); only the Trades page shows a grouped trade once
rationale: Row 12; one rule everywhere except the Trades page (row 13)

decision: Filtering by an account or a group follows that account's own fields: type; firm and archived status of the follower decide whether its copies show
rationale: Row 12: a follower's totals are its own

decision: Choosing a group in the account filter means the leader's trades plus that group's copies; on the Trades page each trade still shows once
rationale: Row 16 and row 13 together

decision: A leader account cannot be deleted in the app (only archived). An archived leader shows a warning on the Groups tab; deleting the group is the explicit way to end it and removes only the group and its events; never a trade
rationale: Spec section 5: warn instead of silently orphaning

decision: Importing into an account that is only a follower is allowed but warned: its trades already arrive from the leader so they would count twice
rationale: Spec section 5: a follower-only trade is imported as a standalone account

decision: The fills acknowledgment is stored on the group (time it was accepted); the group cannot be made without it
rationale: Row 6; evidence the user accepted it
